home.introduction: I'm a software developer based in Montreal, Canada. Welcome to my portfolio.

about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a software developer early in my career, with experience building and customizing full-stack applications for manufacturing systems.
about.paragraph2: My recent work has involved Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. I also have a background in business administration, alongside my computer programming studies.
